summary: Cover unit (封面) of 湖南农业大学 全日制普通本科生毕业论文(设计) cover template contains 16 source entries. The cover is a fillable cover page (not a terminal keep), so it gets local semantic judgment per source entry. The format preamble (block 1) is a style-obligation context for the whole cover area, split into a fixed section header plus style-only rules for page setup, centering, □ symbol meaning, and the conditional 论文/设计 title rule. The university name and document type are fixed labels with appended format specs. The Chinese and English titles are fill_slots bound to thesis.title.zh and thesis.title.en (the placeholder text occupies the title position). The five basic-info lines (学生姓名 / 学号 / 年级专业及班级 / 指导老师及职称 / 学院) each begin with a leading half-width indent (□□□□□□) treated as style-only layout for left-aligned basic info, followed by a fixed label and colon, then a fill_slot bound to author.name.zh / author.student_id / author.cohort_class / advisor.name.zh (+advisor.title) / author.department. The leading "学□□号" and "学□□院" keep the internal spacing inside the fixed_label since it represents the visual label rendering. The advisor line splits name and title into two fill_slots (advisor.name.zh + □ separator + advisor.title) because the template's "及职称" label indicates both are inputs. "湖南·长沙" is a fixed label. The submission date placeholder "20××年××月" is fill_slot submission.date. The (设计)/(论文) conditional applies to both the document-type label (block 4) and the title placeholder (block 6); it is template-level conditional content and is not a field binding concern.
